# Retail Acronym Quick Reference

A-Z lookup. See the linked files for fuller definitions where noted.

| Acronym | Expansion | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ASN | Advance Ship Notice | Supplier's electronic heads-up that a shipment is en route, with contents/ETA. |
| BOPAC | Buy Online, Pickup At Curb | Curbside pickup — see general-retail-terms.md. |
| BOPIS | Buy Online, Pickup In Store | Order/pay online, collect in-store — see general-retail-terms.md. |
| CDP | Customer Data Platform | Unified customer profile system across channels. |
| COGS | Cost of Goods Sold | The direct cost of the inventory a retailer sold, used to compute margin. |
| DC | Distribution Center | Warehouse between suppliers and stores — see general-retail-terms.md. |
| EBT | Electronic Benefits Transfer | Government benefits payment card (e.g., SNAP); has item-eligibility rules. |
| EDI | Electronic Data Interchange | Standardized B2B document exchange format (POs, invoices, ASNs). |
| KDS | Kitchen Display System | Screen-based order queue replacing paper tickets in QSR kitchens. |
| KPI | Key Performance Indicator | A tracked business metric (e.g., average basket size, attach rate). |
| MSRP | Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price | The "sticker price" a manufacturer recommends. |
| OMS | Order Management System | The system of record for order lifecycle (create, fulfill, cancel, return). |
| P&L | Profit and Loss | Standard financial statement; store-level P&L is a common reporting cut. |
| P@P | Pay@Pump | Paying for fuel at the dispenser — see qsr-cstore-terms.md. |
| PIM | Product Information Management | System of record for product content/attributes feeding catalog and POS. |
| PLU | Price Look-Up code | Short numeric code for ringing up items without a barcode scan. |
| POS | Point of Sale | The checkout system/terminal where a transaction is completed. |
| QSR | Quick-Service Restaurant | Fast-food-style restaurant format — see qsr-cstore-terms.md. |
| RMA | Return Merchandise Authorization | Approval/tracking record for a physical product return. |
| SKU | Stock Keeping Unit | Unique identifier for one sellable product variant — see general-retail-terms.md. |
| SSTK | Safety Stock | The buffer inventory kept to absorb demand/supply variability without stocking out. |
| WMS | Warehouse Management System | System controlling receiving, put-away, picking, and shipping inside a DC. |
